# Third-party files hosted with AUREUM

| File | What | License |
|---|---|---|
| `supabase.js` | Supabase JavaScript client (`@supabase/supabase-js` v2, UMD build) | MIT |
| `xlsx.full.min.js` | SheetJS Community Edition 0.18.5 (Excel import/export) | Apache-2.0 |
| `fonts/inter-*.woff2` | Inter (via Fontsource) | SIL Open Font License 1.1 |
| `fonts/jetbrains-mono-*.woff2` | JetBrains Mono (via Fontsource) | SIL Open Font License 1.1 |
| `fonts/fraunces-*.woff2` | Fraunces (via Fontsource) | SIL Open Font License 1.1 |

They are served from AUREUM's own domain, so opening the app sends nothing to Google Fonts or a CDN,
and the app keeps working with no internet connection once loaded.
